description: This source file implements a logging callback class for a generic API endpoint, including helper functions for configuration loading, environment variable substitution, and batch logging operations. It integrates with other components such as HTTP clients, logging utility, and environment configurations to support logging success and failure events asynchronously.

classes.name: GenericAPILogger
classes.description: A custom logger class that batches log events and sends them asynchronously to a specified API endpoint, with support for callback-based configuration, environment variable substitution, and batch management.

methods.name: async_log_success_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Asynchronously logs a success event by adding it to the batch queue and optionally sending the batch if size exceeds threshold.

methods.description: Asynchronously logs a failure event similarly to success events, with batching.
